verificationLog.notes: Applied the founder-confirmed cloud subscription roster: Basic includes GPT-5.4 Nano and excludes GPT-5.4 Mini and Claude Haiku 4.5; Haiku remains Pro+. Max+ intentionally inherits the Max model roster and differs through budget and product limits, not additional model names. GPT-5.4 Nano identity, context, modalities, endpoints, and pricing were rechecked against the official OpenAI model page and OpenRouter catalog on 2026-07-17. This changes admission only; runtime profiles and harness status still fail closed independently.

Corrected the current OpenAI and Anthropic API roster from first-party documentation and live account probes. OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna are GA and selectable: GET model metadata and minimal Responses requests returned HTTP 200 for all three on 2026-07-15, superseding the stale 2026-07-10 account-specific 404. Official OpenAI model pages and pricing confirm exact IDs, 1,050,000 context, 922,000 maximum input, 128,000 maximum output, 2026-02-16 knowledge cutoff, text+image input, and short-context prices. Anthropic model metadata and minimal Messages requests returned HTTP 200 for claude-fable-5, claude-opus-4-8, claude-sonnet-5, and claude-haiku-4-5; official model, effort, and pricing pages confirm context/output limits, reasoning controls, and 5-minute/1-hour prompt-cache rates. Sonnet 5 introductory prices expire 2026-08-31. Availability is kept separate from AGI harness implementation: OpenAI provider-native Responses tools remain marked unwired where AGI has not connected them. Sources retrieved 2026-07-15: developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/latest-model, developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.6-sol, developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.6-terra, developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.6-luna, developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, openai.com/index/gpt-5-6, platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview, platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing, and platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort.

Replaced the Desktop Google Batch app-owned gemini-embedding-001 default with the current gemini-embedding-2 model in the canonical registry. Official Google Gemini Embeddings documentation lists gemini-embedding-2 as the latest multimodal embedding model (April 2026), with text, image, video, audio, and PDF input, an 8,192-token input limit, flexible 128-3,072 dimensions, $0.20 per 1M standard text-input tokens, and $0.10 per 1M Batch text-input tokens. Embedding spaces are incompatible with gemini-embedding-001, so data migration/re-embedding remains an explicit application concern rather than an alias redirect. Sources retrieved 2026-07-15: ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/embeddings and ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing.

Moved Web video reservations onto canonical per-second model pricing. Official Google Gemini API pricing lists Veo 3.1 Standard at $0.40/second for 720p and 1080p and $0.60/second for 4k; the Veo guide requires 8-second output for 1080p/4k. Official Runway pricing lists gen4_turbo at 5 credits/second with credits costing $0.01 ($0.05/second). Sources retrieved 2026-07-15: ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing, ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/veo, docs.dev.runwayml.com/guides/pricing, and docs.dev.runwayml.com/api-details/api_changelog.

Replaced legacy gpt-5-nano with current gpt-5.4-nano. Official OpenAI model documentation confirms exact ID gpt-5.4-nano, model type reasoning, snapshot gpt-5.4-nano-2026-03-17, 400K context, 272K maximum input, 128K maximum output, text+image input, text output, Responses + Chat Completions + Batch support, and reasoning efforts none/low/medium/high/xhigh. Official pricing is $0.20 input, $0.02 cached input, and $1.25 output per 1M tokens. AGI selects the Responses path for this reasoning model. Provider-native web search and hosted tools remain false in the legacy global capability flags until each application route actually wires them; those features belong in the future route/harness registry rather than intrinsic model metadata.

Founder directive: capabilities.search must be true only for models that GENUINELY produce web results today, false for every model where it would be a cosmetic no-op. Traced the full request path (apps/web/lib/web-search-support.ts + request-processor.ts appendWebSearchTool + each provider's translate/wire layer), not just the provider allowlist. Anthropic (claude-opus-4.8/claude-sonnet-4.6/claude-haiku-4.5) and Google (gemini-3.1-pro-preview/gemini-3.1-flash-lite/gemini-3.5-flash) confirmed working end-to-end: web_search_20260209 / google_search survive translate.ts untouched into the wire call; gemini-3.5-flash additionally has a live-recorded groundingMetadata integration test. Kept search:true — no change. OpenAI (gpt-5.5/gpt-5.6-*/gpt-5.4-mini/gpt-5-nano/gpt-4.1-nano) confirmed NOT working on the web route: adapter-factory.ts hardcodes useResponsesApi:false, and packages/ai/providers/openai/src/translate.ts's OPENAI_RESPONSES_ONLY_TOOL_TYPES strips web_search_preview before the wire (it is Responses-API-only) — every OpenAI model was already search:false; left unchanged, but do NOT flip any OpenAI model true until the web route grows a real Responses-API path. CORRECTED 4 cosmetic-true models to false: grok-4.3 (xai), qwen-max and qwen-3.5-plus (qwen), kimi-k2.6 (moonshot) — appendWebSearchTool has no injection branch for xai/qwen/moonshot (confirmed by request-processor.web-search.test.ts and web-search-support.test.ts, which already document xai/qwen/moonshot as no-wired-path providers), and repo-wide search found zero wiring of any provider's real native mechanism either (xAI Agent Tools web_search/x_search tool -- the older search_parameters flag it replaces was retired by xAI on 2026-01-12; Qwen DashScope enable_search request param; Moonshot builtin_function $web_search tool -- all real, current, documented APIs per provider docs, just not called anywhere in this codebase). These 4 are the WP4 target list: wiring any of them up requires provider-specific request shaping (a boolean param for Qwen, a tool-array entry for Moonshot, a tool-array entry for xAI), not one generic mechanism. apps/desktop/src/__tests__/modelRouter.test.ts:42-45 asserts grok-4.3 capabilities.search===true on the premise 'Grok has built-in real-time data access' -- that premise is stale (xAI search has never been automatic; it always required an explicit opt-in mechanism, and AGI never wired one up); flagged for the desktop owner to update, not changed here (out of this pass's scope).

OpenAI verified from official OpenAI developer documentation before catalog repair: gpt-5.5 is the latest text/agent flagship, gpt-5.4-mini remains the latest mini-family model, and gpt-image-2 is the latest GPT Image model available to this product catalog. Anthropic verified from platform.claude.com/docs: current Claude API IDs are claude-opus-4-8, claude-sonnet-4-6, and claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 / alias claude-haiku-4-5. Google verified from ai.google.dev and deepmind.google: gemini-3.5-flash is a current Gemini API model with 1M input context, 64K output, function calling, structured output, Search as a tool, and code execution; Standard pricing is $1.50 input, $9.00 output, and $0.15 cached input per 1M tokens. Google media routes verified from official docs: Imagen 4 Fast API ID is imagen-4.0-fast-generate-001 and Veo 3.1 API ID is veo-3.1-generate-preview. AGI keeps unverified OpenAI video IDs out of the selectable catalog and routes video generation to verified Google Veo 3.1 rather than carrying stale video IDs.

Deleted all legacy version-redirect canonicalization entries from openai, anthropic, and xai providers. These are no longer needed: format aliases (dash→dot) are handled by apiModelId lookups in resolveCanonicalTarget(); version redirects (old→new) are unnecessary for a fresh deployment with no users. Cleared managed_cloud.taskRouting (superseded by SLOT_REGISTRY; no active users). Updated glm-5.1 → glm-5.2 per user confirmation that GLM-5.2 was released (June 2026). Pricing, benchmarks, and context window for glm-5.2 carried from glm-5.1 pending API verification.

GLM-5.2 contextWindow confirmed 1M (was 200K). Groq llama-3.3-70b-versatile and llama-3.1-8b-instant marked deprecated (shutdown 2026-08-16). Qwen API IDs updated to Qwen3 generation: qwen-max→qwen3-max, qwen-flash→qwen3.5-flash, qwen-coder-plus→qwen3-coder-plus, qwen-coder-flash→qwen3-coder-flash. qwen-3.6-plus renamed to qwen-3.5-plus (apiModelId qwen3.6-plus did not exist; correct ID is qwen3.5-plus). qwen-turbo marked deprecated (absorbed by qwen3.5-flash). NVIDIA Nemotron models updated to Nemotron 3 family: ultra-253b→nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b, super-49b→nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b, nano-8b→nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b (all 1M ctx). Grok-4.3, DeepSeek V4, Kimi K2.6 confirmed current — no changes needed. Sources: official provider docs, build.nvidia.com, api-docs.deepseek.com, alibabacloud DashScope.

Added missing cheap OpenAI nano models, verified from OpenAI official Compare-models page (developers.openai.com): gpt-5-nano = $0.05 input / $0.01 cached / $0.40 output, 400K ctx, reasoning tokens SUPPORTED (released Aug 2025, still served); gpt-4.1-nano = $0.10 input / $0.03 cached / $0.40 output, 1,047,576 ctx, NO reasoning tokens, fine-tuning supported (released Apr 2025, still served). Added to tierAllowedModels.economy. Prior catalog had no nano tier (cheapest OpenAI was gpt-5.4-mini at $0.75/$4.50). For fixed-price cost control prefer gpt-4.1-nano (cannot emit reasoning tokens). Release dates from public launch info (GPT-5 nano Aug 2025, GPT-4.1 nano Apr 2025); the Compare page shows knowledge-cutoff, not release.

Added GPT-5.6 family (GA 2026-07-09), verified from developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.6-{sol,terra,luna} (platform.openai.com/docs/models now 301s to this host). Exact API IDs gpt-5.6-sol/-terra/-luna; bare alias gpt-5.6 routes to Sol per the sol page. All: 1,050,000 ctx, 128K max output, reasoning+vision+tools+streaming, knowledge cutoff 2026-02-16. Pricing per 1M: sol $5/$0.50/$30, terra $2.50/$0.25/$15, luna $1/$0.10/$6. No dated snapshot IDs published yet for 5.6 (do not invent). computerUse/codeExecution enumerated on the terra page (web search, file search, image generation, code interpreter, computer use, MCP); carried to sol/luna as family-level API tools pending per-page enumeration. gpt-5.5 NOT deprecated: still listed as Default frontier model with gpt-5.5 + gpt-5.5-2026-04-23 IDs; 5.6 launched alongside, not replacing. Benchmarks intentionally omitted for 5.6 (none published on the model pages).

REVERTED the gpt-5.6 family (sol/terra/luna) added 2026-07-09 — LIVE curl to api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions with a real key returns HTTP 404 'model does not exist' for gpt-5.6-sol/-terra/-luna and bare gpt-5.6. The 2026-07-09 'verified from developers.openai.com' claim was a documentation hallucination, not provisioned models. Confirmed REAL and retained: gpt-5.5 (HTTP 200 with max_completion_tokens; the earlier 400 was the max_tokens-vs-max_completion_tokens param, not model absence), gpt-5.4/-mini/-nano/-pro, gpt-5-nano, gpt-4.1-nano. Latest real OpenAI flagship in this account = gpt-5.5. Lesson: verify model IDs against a live API call, not just doc pages.

Added additive per-model `reasoning` capability blocks (control/supportedEfforts/defaultEffort/canDisableThinking/thinkingBudget/request paths) for every served model, sourced from docs/research/reasoning-effort-capability-matrix-2026-07-10.md (live-probed 2026-07-10). Fixed claude-haiku-4.5 capabilities.thinking false->true (live 200 with thinking_tokens; control=thinking_budget classic enabled+budget, NOT adaptive). Added GPT-5.6 family (sol/terra/luna) as availability:"coming_soon" (LIVE 404 on our key 2026-07-10 — NOT provisioned); bare gpt-5.6 will alias to Sol at GA (no canonicalization alias added this wave — the family is non-routable while coming_soon); kept OUT of tierAllowedModels/SLOT_REGISTRY/taskRouting/defaultModel (enforced by new check:availability-invariant). 5.6 reasoning ladder none/low/medium/high/xhigh/max (max above xhigh). Ultra (multi_agent.enabled + max_concurrent_subagents, beta responses_multi_agent=v1), Pro (reasoning.mode:"pro"), persistent reasoning (reasoning.context), and programmatic tool calling (tool type programmatic_tool_calling + allowed_callers) are RESPONSES-API-ONLY and INERT this wave — our web chat route uses /chat/completions, so the at-GA wave must add a Responses path for those four; effort/vision/tools work on the existing chat path. Added inert tierPolicy.minTier authored data (NOT used to derive tierAllowedModels this wave — all budget models stay available for testing per founder). Gemini 3.x request path migrated to thinkingConfig.thinkingLevel (thinkingBudget kept as legacy fallback). 5.6 pricing/limits from founder screenshot corpus (Addendum D): ctx 1,050,000, max output 128K, knowledge cutoff 2026-02-16; short-context per-1M sol 5/0.5/30 (cache write 6.25), terra 2.5/0.25/15 (3.125), luna 1/0.1/6 (1.25); INERT longContext price tier sol 10/1/45, terra 5/0.5/22.5, luna 2/0.2/9 (5.6-only additive sub-block, applied by the AT-GA metering wave). reasoningDots sol 5 / terra 4 / luna 3.

claude-opus-4.8.name: Claude 4.8 Opus
claude-opus-4.8.tokenizer_drift_warning: Claude Opus 4.8 inherits the Opus 4.7 tokenizer baseline (re-baselined 2026-04): the same input text can yield 1.0x to 1.35x tokens vs prior Claude families (Sonnet 4.6, Opus <=4.6). Re-baseline cost + latency budgets; cached prompts from earlier models may overshoot the context window. See packages/ai/routing/src/three-tier-router.ts ESTIMATE_INFLATION.

gemini-embedding-2.name: Gemini Embedding 2
gemini-embedding-2.pricingNote: Standard text input $0.20/M tokens; Batch text input $0.10/M tokens. Image/audio/video prices vary by modality.

deepseek-v4-pro.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro
deepseek-v4-pro.pricingNote: DeepSeek made its 75% V4-Pro launch discount permanent on 2026-05-22: flat $0.435/$0.87 per 1M tokens, cache-read $0.003625. No post-promo reversion.

qwen-turbo.name: Qwen Turbo
qwen-turbo.supersedes_note: qwen-turbo no longer updated; use qwen-flash (qwen3.5-flash API ID)

kimi-k2.6.name: Kimi K2.6
kimi-k2.6.supersedes_note: All kimi-k2-* and kimi-k2.5* aliases are EOL 2026-05-25 per Moonshot deprecation notice. Use kimi-k2.6 only; canonicalization map redirects legacy IDs for transitional compatibility.

imagen-4.name: Imagen 4
imagen-4.pricingNote: Imagen 4 standard costs $0.04 per generated image. Google marks the Imagen 4 family deprecated with shutdown scheduled for 2026-08-17.

imagen-4-fast.name: Imagen 4 Fast
imagen-4-fast.pricingNote: Imagen 4 Fast costs $0.02 per generated image. Google marks the Imagen 4 family deprecated with shutdown scheduled for 2026-08-17.

runway-gen-4.name: Runway Gen-4
runway-gen-4.pricingNote: Runway Gen-4 remains an alternate third-party video provider entry. Default AGI video routing uses the verified current Google Veo route unless product policy explicitly chooses Runway.

imagen-4-ultra.name: Imagen 4 Ultra
imagen-4-ultra.pricingNote: Imagen 4 Ultra costs $0.06 per generated image. Google marks the Imagen 4 family deprecated with shutdown scheduled for 2026-08-17.

veo-3.name: Veo 3.1
veo-3.pricingNote: Veo 3.1 Standard with audio: $0.40/second at 720p or 1080p; $0.60/second at 4k. 1080p and 4k require 8-second generations.

stable-diffusion-xl.name: Stable Diffusion XL
stable-diffusion-xl.pricingNote: Legacy SDXL engine entry retained for compatibility only. AGI's hosted Stability adapter uses the current Stable Image Core v2beta endpoint.

stable-image-core.name: Stable Image Core
stable-image-core.pricingNote: Stable Image Core uses Stability AI's v2beta generate/core endpoint and costs 3 credits per successful generation; 1 credit is $0.01.

gpt-image-2.name: GPT Image 2
gpt-image-2.pricingNote: OpenAI image generation guide uses a calculator for gpt-image-2 output-token/cost estimation; common 1024x1024 estimates are $0.006 low, $0.053 medium, and $0.211 high.

groq-llama-3.3-70b.name: Llama 3.3 70B (Groq)
groq-llama-3.3-70b.supersedes_note: Groq shutdown 2026-08-16; replacements on Groq: openai/gpt-oss-120b (70b) / openai/gpt-oss-20b (8b)

groq-llama-3.1-8b.name: Llama 3.1 8B Instant (Groq)
groq-llama-3.1-8b.supersedes_note: Groq shutdown 2026-08-16; replacements on Groq: openai/gpt-oss-120b (70b) / openai/gpt-oss-20b (8b)
